## Source-status finding
Existing theorem statements cover infinitely many simple closed geodesics in every complete finite-volume hyperbolic three-manifold, including nonorientable cases. The closed case relies on Luo–Marković's August 2026 preprint; the nonorientable cusped case uses Xia's cited preprint, alongside Kuhlmann's published orientable cusped result.

**Project disposition remains unsolved / source hold.** The package and separate review verify source identity and statement scope, not the complete correctness of the cited proofs. No campaign discovery, new proof, peer-reviewed status for the preprints, or full campaign resolution is claimed.

## Included
- Exact original problem and the closed/cusped, orientable/nonorientable case split
- Genuine embedded closed geodesics, without an invalid descent argument from a cover
- Bibliographic and source-identity receipts
- Unchanged separate source-coverage review
- Duplicate-target link to upstream ID 20001896; one target and one PR

Zero substantive proof attempts used. Actual author and reviewer model: gpt-6-astra, xhigh.

Queue disposition: **unsolved, 0/5**. The campaign's single queue writer will add this row update. This commit changes only this problem's attempt folder.

No merge or release is requested.
